scripts.build: node tools/build-index.mjs && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models run build && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models-pc run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models run test && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models-pc run test && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.check: node tools/build-index.mjs --check && node tools/validate-catalog.mjs && node tools/freshness-report.mjs --max-age-policy catalog-freshness-policy.json --as-of-catalog-generated-at && node tools/catalog-audit.mjs && node tools/release-catalog.mjs --check
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
scripts.sdk:check: pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models run build && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models run test
scripts.sdk:build: pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models-backend-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/models-app-sdk run build
scripts.route-manifest:check: cargo test -p sdkwork-router-catalog-backend-api --test route_manifest && cargo test -p sdkwork-router-catalog-app-api --test route_manifest
